notes.title: Patch 0.7.8 - Cultist's Cache
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have finally finished the long-awaited patch and are ready to tell you what will change in version 0.7.8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/693d0bbf4534575ccacd1d2689aadde59133e5e4.png

As we mentioned in some previous news posts, most of our time was spent on four new scenes with the cultist, which we added to the previous content. The rest of the changes are not as extensive, but are intended to improve certain aspects to make the game more comfortable and enjoyable for you.

So, here is a list of all the changes:

1. In the second chapter on the island, we added the sound of leaves to the scene with Benno.
2. Fixed typos in the text that players sent us.
3. Added 4 new NSFW scenes with cultist Sarah (text, animations) to previous scenes (prison, captain's cabin, corridor with cabins).
4. Improved and detailed the sprite of Exana de Jirde.
5. Improved and detailed the sprites of Beatrice and Montel, Benno's uncle and aunt
6. In Dentwon prison, when the cultist is released, added a background with a missing door to the cell (according to Fab's text, he removes it, but the background did not change)
7. Improved and detailed the sprite of the merchant in Dentwon
8. Added water to the background before the island during the storm - now it appears in the hold, as described in the text
9. In Anna's cabin, reduced the shadow of the gun that Philipp asks to find. Now it doesn't stand out so much from the background
10. In the first chapter after the battle with the smugglers, added a position with closed eyes for the weasel Ordy (when the weasel is lying on the bed).
11. Updated the sprite of the cultist Sarah so that she stands in a 3/4 position like the others.
12. During Tovenaar's story about the history of the world (after the island), instead of the cabin background, we drew 9 sketches illustrating events from the past.
13. In Anna's cabin, we changed the color of the two dildos to a more natural color.
14. We added artwork of Fabian and Olivia kissing during their date before the storm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/f560ad060f21e145936531f75bb5e6251a630bd8.png

15. In Dentwon, the trade window was updated to match the new one in Fortuna's Shop.
16. Fixed a bug where if you completed only one quest for the elders in Podwodje and left, it was impossible to return to the temple.
17. In the trade window, the button to end the trade has been moved to a more logical location, instead of being at the bottom of the screen.
18. In the mini-game “Drinking” with Ka in the tavern, the background for the tutorial window has been updated, replacing the forgotten test version with the current one.
19. During one of the evening hubs, it was possible to help Miss Brown find her hat. The problem was that if you took the quest but didn't find the hat and went to sleep, the quest remained in the diary forever, but it was impossible to complete it. Now it disappears if you haven't completed this mini-quest.
20. Before starting a new game, we added a window for players who don't know how to turn off mini-games in the options, where you can choose to play with or without mini-games. You can still change this in the options.
21. In the Hissara’s quest, during the escape scene through the caves, we added more sounds for atmosphere.

We are smoothly approaching the next story update and want to release it in July. It will be followed by Chapter 5, which we will most likely also split into several parts (at least the main story, side quests, and endings). We really hope to finish the game next summer.

Additionally, we're pleased to announce a special collaboration! We're now working with TinyHat Studios, they are a publishing label who will be helping us out on the marketing side of things. Now we'll be able to spend more time focusing on the game itself!

They're currently running a special discount across their entire label, which includes Wet Sand- you can get the game at a 30% discount right now, with other games on their label also discounted!

Thank you all very much for your interest and support, and may the warm winds carry you forward, wherever you go!

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.notes:
Hello, pirates! We're here with the 0.7.5 update.

To begin with, we wanted to say that this was the most difficult update for us. And it's not entirely clear why. Everything that could go wrong - went wrong. We redesigned a lot and couldn't understand many things, we procrastinated because of translation problems, but in the end we managed. Yes, some of the details are already on the tests added to the list of the next patch, but the stable basis is there.

In this update, you'll have to finally complete all of the Elders' tasks, help the three girls solve their problems in personal quests, engage in resource gathering, and explore locations around the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/7d29c9efef370bfc4f3e1d343a1fb908cfc8d00c.jpg

So, what awaits you in the update:


 12 new artwork


 7 NSFW scenes


 A redesigned trade window, which we'll put in the past content as well


 More than a dozen new backgrounds


 2 original tunes


 1 new sprite


 5 new mini games


 Game time increased by +-2 hours


If you find any errors/bugs, please let us know and we will fix everything. We would like to thank everyone who supports us, because you are the force that moves the project forward! We hope you will like the update and we are already working on the continuation!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.8
notes.notes:
Fixed typos in all languages
 Fixed logic bugs
 Added 2 new items (folder with Olivia's documents and poison vial) that were missed earlier
 Animated 20 static frames
 NSFW scenes are cut with precise addition of sounds
 Added ability to name saves as you wish
 Added new missing sounds (sizzling fried chicken, knocking on the door, etc.)
 Optimized code and reduced weight


Hi friends,

We are late with the release of the update, but there are reasons for that, which we wrote about earlier. But to make it up to you, we decided to prepare a patch in the form of a bunch of different fixes and improvements of past content. Let's tell you what's changed:

First of all, the most important change - there are more animations. We animated 20 static images, including both 16+ scenes and regular images, which became more epic. In addition to these animations, we improved and updated ALL 18+ scenes, intelligently adding sounds so that visuals and sounds connect correctly. Initially there was a grand plan to improve NSFW scenes and everything almost worked out, but the catch was that we focused on the example of other games on another engine, but on RenPy it turned out to be more complicated and not so beautiful. But it is what it is!

Among other things, we made a list of 53 edits (!) from typos to logic and from new sounds to adding missing items. Individually, these bugs were of little interest to anyone, but in total, fixing them has significantly transformed the game. We have changed the icons of hearts on the choices in the dialog so that the text correctly displayed and did not cover the number next to it; added the sound of preparing meat when Benno cooks and other rains, slaps, kisses, etc.; finally fixed the error in the logic when finding a folder with documents in the chest - now Fab takes it to himself and the item will appear in the inventory; the same will happen with the vial of poison, which he will take from Ordi; during Tovi's story about the past and artifacts now all items are named correctly (because before they were 1 more and instead of a blade were boots); in several dialogs added sprites, where they were implied, but we missed; fixed a bug where Benno was drawn in the background in old clothes after her quest.

This small update is meant to improve old content, but don't think this is the only thing being done! The main update is in process and is being prepared! Due to some difficulties we're slowing down with it, but overall it's going well. The story sequel will be quite big, there will be mini games and 18+ scenes and personal character quests. We've even started drawing sprites and backgrounds for the last update in Podvodje, so everything is great! We may have something to show you, by the way:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/bd6f6708ccf3e0f0f4ec5bb9de2f7cac83bb09df.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/05e4d8a27c56492d50e59bd3f753a11267eaaec6.jpg

notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and yo ho ho!

Four months have passed since the last update and we are ready to present you the next update of the underwater part (2/4). Let's tell you what has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/ed2b1b1d05a2ce68dfd47a594038b7aef82179d2.jpg
What changed in version 0.6.6


 We continue to animate previous NSFW scenes and this time we got to Sorna. In this update we have animated two scenes with her.


 Added two new NSFW scenes that are also animated and both of them will take place in the most appropriate place for this - a brothel.


 Added 4 new character sprites, three of which are NOT human.


 Added 5 new items. Some of them are quest items, but there are also planned items for team members that will improve relationships, if you get out from underwater of course :)


 Added 2 changes to past character sprites. These are either minor changes, like changing the shape of the hat, or something that will stay with the character forever... such as on the face.


 Added 14 new backgrounds, and they are as marvelous as ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/bc265bea16a86f50b77fbdfaef95927fe7b33bcf.jpg

 Added 7 new full images that are sure to please your taste, as they are both cozy and spooky and romantic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/3267bfb11740afc15868ca8836eb55befb19cbc3.jpg

 Fixed various bugs from past updates. Typos, game crashes, logic problems. Many thanks to all the players who pointed out the bugs to us!


 The game time has been increased by ~2 hours. Of course, everything is individual again, but if you read the text carefully and look at the new images, you can get even 3 hours! And it's not just 'artificially dragging out gameplay', it's revealing characters and world!


Hurry up and try the new content and come back with feedback, criticism and suggestions!

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Let's go underwater!

Crew, we've prepared a small update in which you'll get to explore the underwater world. There is a big journey planned, which will not yield to the time spent on the island in the second chapter. We have divided the adventure into 4 parts of different sizes and now you can evaluate the first of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/bc85a6b719cee53248317dfb07a6504d75e0d8f9.jpg

What has changed in version 0.6.4


 Fixed typos in the text of the past content (many thanks to those who sent us in Discord found errors - you helped us a lot!).



 Redrawn Dolores images from the beginning of the game. Over the course of development, we notice how skills grow and periodically revisit past content. It was decided to update the images from the beginning of the game to match the increased level.



 A dream scene with a flashback of Dolores was redrawn and animated. We are seamlessly transforming static NSFW images into animations. In this update, we've gone back and redrawn and animated Fabian's flashback scene of his time with Dolores.



 Four new sprites have been added. These are part of the characters you will interact with underwater.



 Fixed bugs in the readout of completed quests. There were a few bugs where quests didn't count under some conditions, or didn't disappear after completion.



 Added two full images + terrain map. We enjoyed drawing maps for the island, Quonter, the whole world, and here we decided to prepare a location map too.



 Added four new backgrounds. They are magical.



 The game time has increased by ~30 minutes. It's hard to estimate the volume - in what to count it? In the number of new images, text? We'll take the time in the game as a basis for now (though, of course, everything is individual).


Thank you for staying with us and supporting the project! All the best!

notes.title: Wet Sand: Chapter 3 — Release
notes.notes:
Hey! Hello, dear players! Finally we and you have waited for the release of chapter 3! The winds are blowing the sails and swiftly sending Drunken Dragonfly on her way for bounty and good stories!

Let's get right to it. Here's what's in store for you in this update:


 Remember the mini-games "shooting", "hole-patching", "steering", "Tailwind"? We are adding 3 more mini-games to them, which will immerse you in the world of the game even deeper. One of them will be with our pointy-eared beauty, the second one will be with Anna  and an unnamed character, and the third one will be in one of the side quests, where you will have to take command of... but not the ship (so be sure to try them all!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/9113f6bf5a32fd9ec385024f02cfe62dcfd69e32.png


 We realize that the numbers don't really convey the volume, but still we have to say how much has been added. There are 10 new sprites, including both important main characters and minor ones. About 13 changes in old sprites: new clothes, recycling of emotions, hairstyles, poses and much more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/35c75ba8c5b03dcc7e9fb3c97bd143a6b4dbb81b.png


 With a total of about 38 wonderful new backgrounds and full images, you'll visit new cities, meet old acquaintances and go on the world map, where you'll sail the seas on your glorious ship! Also 9 new NSFW scenes are waiting for you, including 7 animations! Yes, yes, there are animations in the game now and we are very proud of them. We also animated all the NSFW scenes from chapters 1 and 2 and now the game looks and feels even more cohesive and consistent. We made sure not to offend anyone, so this chapter will have racy scenes with all the main characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/105f6a14ed298a03e3e9da13d2af8a9ff963e943.png


 The story has been greatly expanded and 3 full-fledged side quests with Benno, Lauren and Olivia have been added. The chapter turned out to be quite extensive (to be exact, it is 2 times bigger than the first chapter!) and if you go through it thoughtfully and try all three side quests, you will get about 6 hours of gameplay. We want to warn you - it's better to start the game again to avoid mistakes and bugs (we fixed the previous chapters too), but most importantly - to see the NSFW scenes for sure, as they will require a certain amount of relationship points and it's better to start collecting them from the beginning. Choose wisely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/05caf34b6d75698fcefefc75a435422705b870a4.png


 Made a few changes to past content based on your requests: added training for the card game Tailwind; in the gallery, all images will now be numbered and titled; fixed a couple backgrounds from past chapters; removed blank pages from the inventory (one is enough for everything); added pages to the relationship book (team grows); changed the final window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/14ebcbb2ccfcb3712b5996de53f3f4f14891292f.png


 In response to requests from players who didn't like the card game Tailwind, we've added it to the list of those mini-games that can be skipped with a checkmark in the settings. Now, if you have no desire to break away from the text narrative, you can avoid all mini games completely. But the immersion in the game is much better with them ;)


In addition to in-game content, we've finally gone through all the circles of hell and added items to Steam!
4 levels of badges (+ metal one)
5 emotions
5 profile backgrounds
6 cards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/08258283b9aed0bf179a10c34b7d9202fee79cbb.png

And also chapter 3 brought 20 more new achievements!

Among other things, we corrected typos in previous chapters, added dots at the end of sentences where there were none, added sounds where they were intended but not present, and added or corrected emotions on sprites where they were displayed incorrectly or not changed.

For us, this chapter was quite difficult and brought a lot of challenges. We tried very hard and would like to hear from you - how did we do?

Once again we would like to thank you sincerely for your interest, for waiting and supporting us! There are two more chapters to come and we are looking forward to your feedback to make the game better!

notes.title: Wet Sand Release, Future Plans and Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Wet Sand is officially released on Steam Early Access! Your interest in the game, your feedback and support gave us the energy to move forward with a vengeance.

At first, we planned to spend the first weeks fixing the bugs and problems encountered by the players, but fortunately, no serious problems were identified by anyone. This confirms that our testers and programmer did a great job! It also means that we will most likely not release minor patches and will immediately move on to the development of Chapter 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43220061/e974e875b694bd2e4923c47eb76a6b375328c36b.png

This is what our preliminary release plan looks like

A little later, we plan to share some development news with you. But for 
now - anchors away!
